description: Same-day priority — deep laceration on the hand requiring stitches. Bleeding is controlled but wound depth is concerning. Not immediately life-threatening.

mock_input.raw_transcript: I cut my hand pretty bad while chopping vegetables about an hour ago. I’ve got a cloth wrapped around it and the bleeding has mostly stopped, but the cut looks really deep and long, maybe like 4 centimetres? I don’t think it’ll close on its own. No numbness or anything weird, I can still move my fingers fine.
